snippet.description:
Meet Atul Garg Sir, Ethics faculty at LevelUp IAS, with over a decade of experience teaching Ethics for UPSC Civil Services Examination.
Since Ethics was introduced in the UPSC Mains examination in 2013, Atul Garg Sir has been teaching the subject and helping aspirants understand GS Paper 4: Ethics, Integrity and Aptitude.

In this video, Santosh Kumar Sir highlights why aspirants should carefully evaluate a faculty member’s experience, teaching style and background before choosing a UPSC coaching institute. Watch demo lectures, understand the teaching approach, and make an informed decision about your UPSC preparation.

If you are preparing for UPSC CSE 2027 or 2028, choosing the right guidance can make a difference in your preparation journey.

#UPSC #UPSC2028 #UPSC2027 #UPSCEthics #GS4 #EthicsForUPSC #AtulGargSir #UPSCPreparation #UPSCFaculty #LevelUpIAS
